intro.title: Aventurine Peridot Bracelet
intro.description: Natural, untreated Aventurine Peridot Bracelets, in different designs. The lovely Green Aventurine Bracelets come in various bead shapes, like elliptical, cushion etc. They nurture the heart, help to understand and accept self, bring prosperity, joy, hope etc. The admirable Peridot Bracelet in faceted beads when worn heals the heart, aligns it, helps to forgive and let go of the past, heals relationships, and brings abundant energies. Wear the Peridot Bracelets to alleviate anger, anxiety, fear. Aventurine Peridot Bracelets make loving gifts for loved ones.
